items.title: SPEECH CONTROL
items.quote: My tongue is [like the] pen of a skillful scribe.
items.text: When you speak, choose your words carefully to say what you really mean, as though you were writing them for posterity.

items.title: MORALE BOOST
items.quote: Therefore, G-d has blessed you throughout your life.
items.text: Through carefully chosen words, boost the morale and give encouragement to a young couple entering marriage..

items.w: חגור חרבך על ירך גבור הודך והדרך
items.title: PREPARATION FOR LIFE
items.quote: Gird your sword upon [your] thigh, O mighty warrior. [Victory for Torah and truth will be] your triumph and your glory.
items.text: Prepare yourself for the responsibilities of building a home by learning Torah.

items.title: HUMILITY
items.quote: Righteous humility at your right hand will teach you awesome things.
items.text: Live your life with humility, rejecting deception, falsehood, and pride.

items.title: TRUTH
items.quote: Your throne is [the truth that comes from the throne] of G-d, which is eternal.
items.text: In building and administering your home let your guideline always be the truth of G-d.

items.quote: A scepter of integrity is the scepter of your kingdom.

items.title: GARBED IN GOODNESS
items.quote: [The fragrance of] myrrh, aloes, and cassia, [pervades] all your garments.
items.text: Let your middos and good deeds be like sweet smelling clothing that enhances your physical body.

items.title: LISTEN
items.quote: Hear, O daughter, and see. Incline your ear.
items.text: Be receptive to the wisdom of those who preceded you. Don’t be confused by youthful fantasies.

items.w: ובת צר במנחה פניך יחלו עשירי עם
items.title: SIMPLE LIVING
items.quote: [Don’t be seduced by] the power of temptation bearing a gift [of worldly luxury], sought by the richest of the nation.
items.text: Don’t be misled by the seductive temptations of luxury.

items.title: TRUE FULFILLMENT
items.quote: The entire glory of the princess is within her home.
items.text: Your true fulfillment is not to be found in the false sophistication of society or material wealth.

items.title: WORTHY CHILDREN
items.quote: May your sons be [worthy of stepping] into the place of your fathers.
items.text: Ask Hashem to bless you with worthy children that are able and willing to be living links in the chain of Torah tradition.

items.title: HISTORY
items.quote: I will make your name to be remembered in all generations.
items.text: Make a contribution to the world that Hashem created. Try to live your life so that it will be sufficiently worthy to be remembered by succeeding generations.
